events.title: Moving Forward And Recent Events
events.description: Omniscient announced changes including the removal of long-time members as part of a new direction for the community. He acknowledged change is uncomfortable but necessary for progress, and encouraged remaining members to contribute ideas and skills.

events.title: Userbars: Aliens vs Cosmic Poll
events.description: Omniscient launched a community poll to choose between two new userbar themes — Aliens and Cosmic. The Aliens design was leading at the time of writing.

events.title: Group Convo Rooms
events.description: Omniscient is converting Group Convo Rooms (GCRs) to function more like the old Public Convo Room — only the latest 20 messages will display, with no notifications, and fun features like /flip and /rain returning. Socket-based features may be unstable during development.

events.title: Awards
events.description: uid 5343398 received the Speaker of the House award. uid 113707 and uid 564681 received the King Decade award.

events.title: Group & Crew News
events.description: Succubus group remains listed for sale. Olympians and Benevolence groups listed for sale by uid 1342286.
